snp1.8:0.2: The Discourse on how Friendliness Meditation should be Done
snp1.8:1.1: What should be done by one skilled in goodness,
snp1.8:1.2: who has comprehended the state of peace:
snp1.8:1.3: he ought to be able, straight,
snp1.8:1.4: and upright, easy to speak to, meek, without conceit,
snp1.8:2.2: free from duties, and light in living,
snp1.8:2.4: not forward, and greedless among the families,
snp1.8:3.1: he should not do the slightest thing whereby others who are wise might find fault (with him).
snp1.8:3.3: “(May all beings) be happy and secure,
snp1.8:3.4: may all beings in their hearts be happy!
snp1.8:4.1: Whatsoever breathing beings there are - trembling, firm, or any other (beings),
snp1.8:4.3: whether they be long or great,
snp1.8:4.4: of middle (size), short, tiny, or of compact (body),
snp1.8:5.2: those who are seen, and those who are unseen, those who live far away, those who are near,
snp1.8:5.3: those who are born, and those who still seek birth may all beings in their hearts be happy!”
snp1.8:6.2: nor should he despise anyone wherever he is,
snp1.8:6.3: he should not long for suffering for another because of anger or resentment.
snp1.8:7.1: In the same way as a mother would protect her child, her only child, with her life,
snp1.8:7.3: so too towards all beings one should develop the measureless thought (of friendliness).
snp1.8:7.4: Towards the entire world he should develop the measureless thought of friendliness,
snp1.8:9.1: Standing, walking, sitting, lying, for as long as he is without torpor,
snp1.8:9.3: he should be resolved on this mindfulness,
snp1.8:9.4: for this, they say here, is the (true) spiritual life.
snp1.8:10.3: having removed greed towards sense pleasures,
snp1.8:10.4: he does not come to lie in a womb again.
